clue.text: Exclamation of mistake from doctor attending surgical procedures

indicators.note: attending means accompanying, so one piece sits beside the other

parts.note: Doctor Who is the time-travelling hero of the BBC science-fiction series
OPS is the short form of operations

explanation.surface: A doctor present at operations lets slip a cry of dismay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' is not DR or MO here but the TV Time Lord, Doctor Who.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is the cry people make on realising they have blundered or dropped something.

clue.text: Overheard complaint initially about student that waiter brings?

indicators.note: overheard means caught by ear, so the next word counts as spoken

parts.note: a whine is a moaning complaint
L, for learner, is a student driver's plate
initially means at first, which can be written 1ST, with the figure read as I

explanation.surface: A grumble overheard about a student, which a waiter brings to the table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' becomes 1ST, read as the letters IST. The question mark marks the definition as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: In a restaurant the server hands over the menu of available bottles for the diner to choose from.

clue.text: Indian is one from Haryana ecologist upset

indicators.note: upset says the hidden letters are read backwards
from says the letters are taken out of the run of words that follows

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An environmental scientist from Haryana is unhappy.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft lacked an indicator for the hidden step: 'from' signals it. 'Indian' looks like a person from Haryana, an Indian state; it is the Indian Ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: The Indian is one of the world's great bodies of salt water, alongside the Atlantic and Pacific.

clue.text: Warning powerful rainstorm's beginning to come in

indicators.note: to come in means to enter, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: potent means powerful

indicators.note: beginning picks out the first letter of rainstorm's

explanation.surface: A warning that a mighty rainstorm is about to arrive.
explanation.definitionFit: A portent is an omen that warns of something about to happen.

clue.text: Language buff

definitions.meaning: the tongue spoken in Warsaw and across that nation
to buff is to rub a surface until it shines

explanation.surface: Language buff
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the Slavic tongue of Poland; the other is the verb meaning to make shiny by rubbing.

clue.text: Foreign banker loves keeping Republican in touch regularly

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so the two Os enclose the rest

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, written O, so two of them

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of touch

explanation.surface: An overseas financier loves a Republican who keeps in touch.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'banker' in crosswords is often a river, which has banks; this one is in Venezuela.
explanation.definitionFit: The great river of Venezuela is a foreign waterway, and rivers are crossword bankers.

clue.text: Repeatedly discovered fine string so essential

indicators.note: discovered means with its cover taken off, done to each of the two words that follow

parts.note: sic is Latin for so or thus

explanation.surface: A fine string was found again and again, so it was vital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discovered' is read as dis-covered: FINE and STRING lose their outer letters, giving IN and TRIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Something intrinsic belongs to the basic nature of a thing, so it is fundamental.

clue.text: Set tough English examination at last

parts.note: hard means tough

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of examination

explanation.surface: Setting a difficult English exam at long last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set' looks like setting a paper; it is the verb for becoming firm.
explanation.definitionFit: To set and to harden both mean to become solid, as concrete or jelly does.

clue.text: Gathered parent essentially is stopping friend travelling

indicators.note: is stopping means the core sits inside, plugging the gap in the other letters
travelling suggests the letters of friend moving about into a new order
essentially points to the essence, the core letters of parent with its ends dropped

explanation.surface: A parent's presence holds up a friend on a journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gathered' looks like collected, but it is the sense of concluded.
explanation.definitionFit: To gather something can mean to deduce it from evidence, as in 'I gather you're leaving'.

clue.text: Fail to catch someone in, perhaps?

definitions.text: Fail to catch someone in, perhaps?

parts.words: Fail to catch someone in, perhaps?
parts.note: in cricket a fielder who spills a catch lets the batter who is in stay at the crease; the idiom means to fail generally

explanation.surface: Fail to catch someone in, perhaps?
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the batter currently at the crease is 'in'; a dropped catch keeps them there.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to fail or blunder, from a fielder spilling a catch.

clue.text: One after another articulate apprentice

indicators.note: to articulate is to speak out, so what follows is a word as pronounced

parts.note: an intern is a trainee learning on the job

explanation.surface: A trainee who speaks well, one after the next.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in sequence, each taking a go after the one before.

clue.text: Finish off aircraft design

indicators.note: finish off here means lop off the finish, the last letter of the word

parts.note: a plane is an aircraft

explanation.surface: Completing the blueprint for an aeroplane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Finish off' reads as 'complete' but means cut off the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A design is a scheme or blueprint for how something will be made or done.

clue.text: Cut back on comedies broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast scatters the letters widely, mixing them into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: The channel trims spending on the comedies it airs.
explanation.definitionFit: To cut back is to reduce spending, saving money by spending less.

clue.text: Flashy style, one's suit to a T!

indicators.note: to style is to arrange or fashion, so the letters given are rearranged

explanation.surface: A showy fashion: someone's outfit fits them perfectly.
explanation.definitionFit: Flashy and showy both describe a display designed to impress others.

clue.text: Based on observation, claim pier suffered damage

indicators.note: suffered damage means wrecked, so the letters are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: An insurance claim follows observed damage to a seaside pier.
explanation.definitionFit: Empirical knowledge comes from experiment and experience rather than theory.

clue.text: Stand is quiet at Leeds surprisingly

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

indicators.note: surprisingly hints at an unexpected order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The football stand is oddly silent at Leeds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stand' suggests a football stand at Leeds; it is the base for a statue.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedestal is the base or support on which a statue or vase stands.

clue.text: Type of bread in grill with very bare metal

parts.note: to grill someone is to pump them for information

indicators.note: bare means stripped, so the word very loses its outer letters

parts.note: nickel is a metallic element

explanation.surface: A kind of loaf cooked under the grill on a stripped metal tray.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a dark, dense German rye loaf.

clue.text: Rising actor receives award that's primarily for play

indicators.note: receives means takes in, so the reversed word holds the others
rising in a down clue means read from the bottom up, so backwards

parts.note: a ham is an over-acting actor
the CBE is a British honour, Commander of the Order of the British Empire

indicators.note: primarily picks the first letter of that's

explanation.surface: An up-and-coming actor wins a prize, mainly for a stage play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rising' gives MAH from bottom to top in a down clue; the CBE is a British honour.
explanation.definitionFit: This Shakespeare tragedy about a Scottish thane is a famous stage drama.

clue.text: Lebanon's to prioritise housing constantly

indicators.note: housing means holding within, so the letters are concealed in the words

explanation.surface: Lebanon is to make housing a priority all the time.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something constantly means without a pause or break.

clue.text: Give false impression female will find confidence

parts.note: to belie is to misrepresent or disguise

explanation.surface: A woman deceives others to get their trust.
explanation.definitionFit: Belief and confidence both mean trust or faith in something.

clue.text: Legendary little guy developing Herculean power is inspired

indicators.note: inspired means breathed in, so the letter is drawn inside
developing means evolving into something new, so the letters re-form

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: A mythical man is driven by a mighty strength.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developing' rearranges HERCULEAN and 'is inspired' sets P inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: This mischievous fairy cobbler of Irish folklore is a small figure from legend.

clue.text: Clarified butter Frenchman maybe picked up

indicators.note: picked up means heard, as a microphone catches a sound

parts.note: Guy is a French man's name, said with a hard G and a long E

explanation.surface: A Frenchman perhaps gets hold of some clarified butter.
explanation.walkthrough: The French say the name Guy with a hard G and a long E, which sounds like the butter.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the clarified butter used in South Asian cooking.

clue.text: Cheddar, for instance, attractive old American ignored

indicators.note: ignored means left out, so these letters are dropped

parts.note: gorgeous means very attractive
US stands for the United States, so American

explanation.surface: A Cheddar cheese is tasty, but American has been overlooked.
explanation.walkthrough: Cheddar Gorge is a limestone ravine in Somerset, England, not only a cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheddar Gorge is a famous English ravine, an example of a deep rocky valley.

clue.text: Ring Eric about touring Cornwall on vacation

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the reversed name surrounds the other piece
about means turned round, so Eric is read backwards
on vacation means emptied, leaving only the outside letters of Cornwall

explanation.surface: Eric phones about a trip round Cornwall during the holidays.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' gives CIRE, and 'on vacation' empties Cornwall, keeping just its outer letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A ring is a round band or hoop, the shape of a round loop.

clue.text: Learned rubbish mostly over period of time

indicators.note: over means covering, so the shortened word goes around the other piece
mostly means most of the word, its final letter dropped

parts.note: litter is rubbish dropped in the street
an era is a long period of history

explanation.surface: Educated on rubbish for a long time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' leaves LITTE, which 'over' wraps round the period of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Learned and well-read both describe someone educated and cultured.

clue.text: Dirty newspaper I left filling hotel yard

indicators.note: filling means stuffing inside, so these letters go into the paper

parts.note: FT is the Financial Times, the pink paper
H is hotel in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: A grubby tabloid stuffed in a hotel courtyard.
explanation.definitionFit: Filthy means very dirty or covered in grime.

clue.text: Review of court decision to attract interest

definitions.meaning: a request for a higher court to reconsider a ruling
a verb meaning to be attractive to someone

explanation.surface: Reconsidering a court ruling, to draw people's attention.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the legal challenge to a verdict; the other is the verb meaning to be attractive.
